ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the graph, there is a linear function $y_1=x+a$ and $y_2=kx+b$ where $k\neq 0$, what is the solution set of the inequality $kx+b \geq x+a$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\because kx+b \geq x+a$,\\
$\therefore y_2 > y_1$,\\
$\therefore$ combining with the graph, it is known that when $x \leq -2$, $y_2 > y_1$.\\
Thus, the answer is: $\boxed{x \leq -2}$.
